title: Mustard Resource Pack
body:
# **MUSTAAARD**
This resource pack replaces **Gold** with **Mustard!**

##  Important Names that ts changes
Raw Gold --> **Mustard** Powder

Gold Ingot --> **Mustard** Bottle

And any other mentions of Gold _(Mustard Helmet, Mustard Sword, etc.)_

## This also changes:
Splash Text

End Text (When you beat the game)

Post Credits (I have no clue what this is but I changed it)

Lava (and any mentions of it in text)
